content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can lose key facts, absorb errors, or follow irrelevant context. This skill helps teams identify degradation patterns and choose mitigation strategies.
actual_capabilities: Explains lost-in-middle, poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash patterns.
Lists symptoms that indicate context-related failure during long agent sessions.
Describes mitigation strategies such as filtering, compaction, isolation, and task segmentation.
Provides guidance for placing critical information at attention-favored positions.
Summarizes benchmark-style thresholds and model behavior patterns for long-context work.
limitations: Does not provide executable tools or automated diagnostics.
Benchmark and model threshold claims require independent validation before operational use.
The referenced patterns.md file is not included in this package.
Guidance must be adapted to each model, task, and context budget.

use_cases.title: Debug Long Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Identify whether a degraded response comes from lost context, poisoned summaries, irrelevant retrieval, or conflicting inputs.

use_cases.title: Design Reliable Context Pipelines
use_cases.description: Plan when to filter, compress, isolate, or reload context before a workflow exceeds reliable attention limits.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Context Engineering Choices
use_cases.description: Create review criteria for long-context behavior, retrieval quality, compaction timing, and task segmentation.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Failure Pattern
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis of a single bad response.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent response and conversation history. Identify the most likely context degradation pattern and explain the evidence in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Find Context Risks
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a planned prompt or retrieval bundle before use.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this context package for lost-in-middle risk, distractors, poisoned content, confusion, and clash. Recommend the top three fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Mitigation Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a context management plan for this workflow. Include when to write, select, compress, and isolate information.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Failures
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of recurring agent failures.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these failure logs against context degradation patterns. Separate evidence, likely causes, mitigation actions, and validation tests.

output_examples.input: A support agent ignores a policy added halfway through a long case history.
output_examples.output: Likely lost-in-middle degradation. Move the policy summary near the current task, add a compact decision note, and retest with shorter context.

output_examples.input: A coding agent keeps using an outdated API after a correction appears later in the chat.
output_examples.output: Likely context poisoning or clash. Remove stale notes, mark the current API as authoritative, and restart from verified state when needed.

output_examples.input: A retrieval workflow performs worse after adding several loosely related documents.
output_examples.output: Likely context distraction. Filter irrelevant documents before loading them and retrieve supporting material only when the task needs it.

best_practices: Place critical instructions and verified facts near the beginning or end of context.
Filter retrieved material before adding it to active context.
Use compaction and task isolation before context length reaches known failure thresholds.
anti_patterns: Treating a larger context window as a substitute for relevance filtering.
Keeping hallucinated summaries in context after they are corrected.
Mixing unrelated tasks in one session without clear boundaries.

faq.question: What problem does this skill address?
faq.answer: It helps users recognize common ways long context can reduce AI response quality.

faq.question: Does this skill run code?
faq.answer: No. It is documentation and analysis guidance only.

faq.question: Can it automatically detect context degradation?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and review prompts, but users must apply them to their own logs or workflows.

faq.question: Which degradation patterns are covered?
faq.answer: It covers lost-in-middle, context poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash.

faq.question: Is the benchmark information authoritative?
faq.answer: No. Treat benchmark and model threshold claims as references that need current validation.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: AI developers, agent architects, and evaluation teams working with long conversations or large retrieval contexts.
